programme.title: Evening Edition / 新闻报报看

programme.title: Food Producers / 生产者 Ep9
programme.desc: Discover the origins of the food you place on your table in this eye-opening food programme produced by Jason Yeoh. Knowing the value of what you eat is the true meaning of food and eating. Learn how your favourite dishes came to be by discovering the origins of daily ingredients by stepping into farms, seas, rivers and food processing plants. Besides exploring the relationship between food and their origins, the processes, environments, and even the weather, also listen to the beliefs of the producers and the recommended cooking methods before presenting the delicious meals.

programme.title: Let's Go Green 2.0 MV / 《一起绿行趣 2.0》主题曲MV

programme.title: My Little Boys / 小儿子S4 Ep2
programme.desc: A-Nee-Gu experiences the ups and downs of life with his family as they celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival. Meanwhile, he also secretly raises a hairy-legged spider with his friends at school.

programme.title: Perfect Match / 非诚勿扰 Ep32

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: Life's Journey Ep2
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own.

programme.title: Wild Castles Ep1
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey.

programme.title: Wild Castles Ep2
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Castles Ep3
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also for the region's wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Castles Ep4
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region's wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Castles Ep5
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada.

programme.title: Planet Shark Ep1
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey's heartbeat.

programme.title: Planet Shark Ep2
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean's vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness.

programme.title: Planet Shark Ep3
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe.

programme.title: Wild Latin America Ep1
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale's life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia.

programme.title: Wild Latin America Ep2
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it's mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Ep1
programme.desc: One of the most majestic, unspoiled and rarely filmed areas in Africa is an exploration of how wildlife including cheetahs, hyenas and elephants survive the cycles of draught and rainfall.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Ep2
programme.desc: One of the most majestic, unspoiled and rarely filmed areas in Africa is an exploration of how wildlife including cheetahs, hyenas and elephants survive the cycles of draught and rainfall.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Ep1
programme.desc: Chart the lion's nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Ep2
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Ep5
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs.
